# GitHub Agent Instructions

## Repository Deletion Is Forbidden

Do not delete this repository, any other local or remote Git repository, a
repository's `.git` directory, Git history, worktrees, branches, tags, or
remotes. Do not re-clone over an existing repository and do not use destructive
cleanup commands in or around a repository.

For duplicate, stale, damaged, disconnected, or misplaced repositories, preserve
all copies and uncommitted work. Record their paths and Git state, then propose a
non-destructive repair.

The complete mandatory policy is in
[`REPOSITORY_SAFETY.md`](../REPOSITORY_SAFETY.md), and the repository-wide agent
instructions are in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
